title: Remove ViewDesigner; consolidate view config into ViewConfigPanel with undo/redo and drag-and-drop
body:
Two competing view configuration systems existed: ViewConfigPanel (right-side panel, schema-driven, actively maintained) and ViewDesigner (full-page editor, legacy). This removes ViewDesigner entirely and upgrades ViewConfigPanel with the capabilities that were unique to ViewDesigner: undo/redo history and drag-and-drop column sorting. ### Deleted - `packages/plugin-designer/src/ViewDesigner.tsx` and its tests - `apps/console/src/components/ViewDesignerPage.tsx` and its tests - Routes: `/:objectName/views/new`, `/:objectName/views/:viewId` ### Cleaned up - **Types**: Removed `ViewDesignerSchema` and `ViewDesignerColumn` from `@object-ui/types`. Renamed the column interface to `ViewColumnConfig` (still used by `UnifiedViewConfig`) - **Exports**: Removed ViewDesigner from `plugin-designer/index.tsx` exports and `ComponentRegistry` - **i18n**: Removed `advancedEditor` key from all 10 locale files - **ObjectView**: Removed "Advanced Editor" dropdown menu item and its test - **Docs**: Updated ROADMAP.md and plugin-designer README to reflect removal ### Upgraded ViewConfigPanel - **Undo/Redo**: Extended `useConfigDraft` hook with `pastRef`/`futureRef` history stacks, exposing `undo`, `redo`, `canUndo`, `canRedo`. Configurable `maxHistory` option (default: 50). Added `onUndo`/`onRedo`/`canUndo`/`canRedo` props to `ConfigPanelRenderer` with Undo2/Redo2 buttons in the header. Wired into ViewConfigPanel with i18n labels. - **Drag-and-drop column sorting**: Integrated `@dnd-kit/sortable` into the field selector via `SortableColumnItem` and `DraggableColumnList` components, replacing the static column list with a drag-to-reorder list while preserving the existing up/down button fallback. ### Tests - 13 new undo/redo tests in `use-config-draft.test.tsx` (initial state, undo/redo flow, multi-step undo, empty history, clear on discard, clear on source change, maxHistory limit) - Updated ViewConfigPanel test mock with matching undo/redo implementation - All 301 tests pass across affected files (21 hook + 139 panel + 110 schema + 31 ObjectView) - No security vulnerabilities in `@dnd-kit` dependencies; CodeQL clean
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 删除列表视图高级编辑器（ViewDesigner）并升级配置面板 > ### 背景 > 目前在项目中存在两套视图配置系统： > 1. ViewConfigPanel（右侧配置面板，Airtable风格）——已被广泛使用，支持全部字段、过滤、排序、外观等配套能力，并采用 schema 驱动架构。 > 2. ViewDesigner（高级编辑器，全页面）——历史遗留，支持拖拽排序、撤销/重做等，但已与主流能力重复，且部分能力已被右侧面板覆盖。 > > ### 存在问题 > - 两套配置能力重复，导致用户困惑、代码维护困难。 > - ViewDesigner 维护成本高，且未跟进新特性（如 toolbar toggles, 导出、导航等），和主流架构不一致。 > - i18n 多语言中存在“advancedEditor”文本，但实际没有入口。 > > ### 处理建议 > 1. 升级 ViewConfigPanel： > - 增加字段拖拽排序功能（可参考 ViewDesigner 现有逻辑，建议复用 @dnd-kit/core）。 > - 增加撤销/重做功能（复用 useDesignerHistory 钩子，集成进 useConfigDraft）。 > - 可选：增加配置拷贝/粘贴功能。 > 2. 移除 ViewDesigner 相关代码： > - 删除 apps/console/src/components/ViewDesignerPage.tsx 路由页面与入口。 > - 删除 packages/plugin-designer/src/ViewDesigner.tsx 组件及导出。 > - 删除 apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewDesignerSave.test.tsx 测试。 > - 清理 packages/types/src/designer.ts 中 ViewDesignerSchema 相关类型。 > - 删除/清理 i18n 各语言文件中的“advancedEditor”文本。 > - 路由中移除 /views/new /:viewId 入口。 > - 更新 README、ROADMAP.md，标记 ViewDesigner 已被配置面板取代。 > > ### 验收标准 > - 配置面板支持拖拽排序和撤销重做。 > - ViewDesigner 及相关代码彻底移除。 > - 文档/多语言/类型同步更新。 > > ### 附图 > > > ### 注意事项 > - 代码同步变更需运行测试（`pnpm test`），并在 ROADMAP/UPDATE_SUMMARY.md 做更新说明。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
